now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
now.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he kills Garrett while Fury looks on.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director Hydra forces Mike to target at Cybertek.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Forced by Hydra to target Fury at Cybertek. Once free, kills Garrett as Fury looks on.

proposed.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he strikes Garrett down while Fury looks on.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Forced by Hydra to target Fury at Cybertek. Once free, strikes Garrett down as Fury looks on.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22 (Beginning of the End): Peterson fires a missile at Garrett and stomps on him, seemingly killing him, but the GH-325 revives Garrett, who upgrades himself with Cybertek machinery and is then vaporized by Coulson with the Peruvian 0-8-4 weapon. Mike does not kill Garrett. The text and Fury's card line both say he does.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
now.text: Raina approaches Carl Creel about the Obelisk he is chasing for HYDRA, offering him a carbyne ring that would protect him from its touch. Creel turns her down, telling her whatever she is offering isn't enough.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A rival for the Obelisk who offers Creel a carbyne ring. He refuses.
now.on_b_card_about_a: HYDRA's man chasing the Obelisk, who turns down Raina's carbyne ring.

proposed.text: Raina approaches Carl Creel about the Obelisk he has stolen for HYDRA, offering him a carbyne ring that would protect him from its touch. Creel refuses her deal and warns her off, but keeps the ring.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A rival for the Obelisk who offers Creel a carbyne ring. He keeps it but refuses her deal.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: HYDRA's man holding the Obelisk, who refuses Raina's deal but keeps her carbyne ring.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2 (Heavy Is the Head): Creel already has the Obelisk, which he stole in S2#1. He refuses Raina's offer and warns her away from HYDRA, but he walks off with the carbyne ring. Later in the same episode he wears it to control the Obelisk's power (the ring also has Raina's tracker in it). So 'turns down Raina's carbyne ring' / 'He refuses' (of the ring) is false, and he is not still 'chasing' the Obelisk.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
now.text: Sunil Bakshi is Daniel Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command, proud to serve a man he calls a disciple of Red Skull. He carries out Whitehall's campaign to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. and recover the Obelisk.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Bakshi's leader, whom he proudly calls a disciple of Red Skull.

proposed.text: Sunil Bakshi is Daniel Whitehall's fiercely loyal second in command. He carries out Whitehall's campaign to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. and recover the Obelisk.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Bakshi's leader, whom he serves with fierce loyalty.

changes.evidence: Bakshi calling Whitehall 'a disciple of Red Skull' is his line to Bobbi Morse during her interrogation of him in S2#8 (The Things We Bury), where he lets slip Whitehall's past. It does not come from S2#1, the stage's own title, so the S2#1 stage uses a later title's line.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#5
now.text: Lance Hunter and Bobbi Morse are exes who were once married. They bicker constantly but fall back in love.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Bobbi's ex-husband. They bicker constantly but fall back in love.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter's ex-wife. They bicker constantly but fall back in love.

proposed.text: Lance Hunter and Bobbi Morse are exes who were once married, and they bicker constantly.

changes.evidence: In S2#5 (A Hen in the Wolf House) Bobbi joins the team and she and Hunter bicker as exes. They only rekindle things in S2#8 (The Things We Bury), when they argue and then sleep together in an SUV. After that they are together (by S2#12 Bobbi tries to end their 'rekindled relationship'). So 'fall back in love' on the S2#5 stage gives away S2#8. Note for the owner: the S2#8 turn has no stage of its own (N5 was out of scope for this recheck).
